treatment: Vendored verbatim under the MIT license. The upstream LICENSE and NOTICE.md ship unmodified next to this file and the copyright notice is preserved; no upstream wording was rewritten or re-attributed. The full upstream tree (except .git and .gitignore) is kept so the upstream validator keeps passing against this copy.
notes: The vendored tree was verified byte-identical (diff -r) to the reviewed commit on 2026-09-03.

scripts/validate_skill.py is executed only by the project test-suite (backend/tests/test_seedance_video_director_skill.py) against this vendored copy. It is a read-only structural validator with no network access and is never imported by the application.

At runtime only Markdown is read: app/core/seedance_video_director.py extracts the provider-specific sections (mode limits, input requirements, timing/reference rules, the selected prompt blueprint, asset-lock and realistic-direction patterns) and appends them as a budgeted director layer to ModelGateway.optimize_video_prompt when, and only when, the target model resolves to Seedance 2.5. The chat-agent behaviours of the upstream Skill (onboarding, clarifying questions, director-brief/diagnosis output modes) are intentionally not wired.
Registered in backend/app/data/upstream_sources.json and backend/app/core/capability_manifest.py as source id seedance-2-5-video-director.
